verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a Unity Profiler, ECS/DOTS, the Job System, Burst, or GPU instancing. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: marketing copy about optimizing high-end games, the AI Assistant's natural-language "analyze performance" feature, and a community comment that Godot lags on profiling. None of these establishes the product's own profiler or data-oriented scaling paths.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can profile and scale — a real profiler, plus data-oriented paths (ECS, jobs, instancing) when scenes get heavy
